== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Ekerinatoth, often referred to by the shortened name [[Ekeri]], is a member of the gold [[dragon]] bloodline. She is a formidable combatant who utilizes a [[technique]] known as the [[Path of the Flowing Flame]], which involves attacking with liquid golden whips. While her combat style is powerful enough to damage creatures like [[dragon]]-turtles, it possesses a predictable nature that allows an observant opponent to anticipate her movements. In battle, she is described as a merciless hunter who seeks to kill rather than persuade or steal. Her physical appearance includes golden [[scales]] and eyes that glow gold when her [[spirit]] is active. She has been seen wearing Jade{{!}}jade-colored silk robes and carrying a specialized weapon resembling a long [[needle]] with a [[sword]] hilt. Additionally, she utilizes portable shelters constructed from [[Forged madra]] and is capable of commanding assistants to aid in her objectives.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Ekerinatoth is a [[dragon-girl]] with the form of a [[dragon]]-turtle. She possesses [[scales]] that are gold in color.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|She utilizes both [[Ruler]] and [[Enforcer techniques]]. Her combat involves the use of a long [[needle]] equipped with a [[sword]]'s hilt.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Ekerinatoth is a [[dragon]]-turtle belonging to the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons. Appearing as a [[dragon-girl]] with golden [[scales]], she wields a unique weapon consisting of a long [[needle]] attached to a [[sword]]'s hilt. During combat, she utilizes both [[Enforcer]] and [[Ruler techniques]].}}
